name: Geo Targetly Geo Popup
author: geotargetly

sections.description:
Geo Popup lets you display targeted popups to website visitors based on their country, region, city, lat-long radius, or IP address.

Whether you’re promoting local deals, announcing region-specific events, or redirecting visitors to country-specific pages, Geo Popup gives you full control over who sees what and when.

Popups can include any custom HTML-rich text, images, video, buttons, forms, or embeds. You can also control layout (width/height), styling, and choose to show popups on desktop, mobile, or both.

Set when popups should appear using display schedules by day, time, and timezone. Plus, avoid annoyance by setting how often the same user sees the popup using cookie-based rules.

Made by Geo Targetly, it’s a flexible tool for any geo-personalized marketing need.

  • Paid account is required – see pricing
  • 14-day free trial – no credit card needed

Features

  • Show popups based on country, region, city, radius, or IP address
  • Create multiple pop-up rules targeting different locations
  • Customize content with rich HTML–text, images, forms, video
  • Control the pop-up design width, height, colors, and background image
  • Choose desktop, mobile, or both
  • Avoid repetition with cookie display frequency rules
  • Schedule popups by day, hour, and the visitor’s timezone
  • Lightweight JS embed – no coding needed

Detailed docs can be found below

  • Overview https://geotargetly.com/geo-popup
  • Quick Start Guide https://help.geotargetly.com/en/articles/2147918-geo-popup-quick-start-guide
  • Docs https://help.geotargetly.com/en/collections/738549-geo-popups

Support

  • Live chat at Geo Targetly

External services

This plugin connects to an external endpoint via the domain https://g10894638425.co to load and run a script that powers its core
functionality, as outlined previously in the description.

It sends the user’s location each time the plugin is loaded. This is necessary to determine and customize the plugin’s
behavior based on the user’s geographical context.

This service is provided by Geo Targetly – Terms of Use,
Privacy Policy.
